Maya (People Ops): Quick heads-up: new emergency leave guidance and local payout clarifications published. Effective Jun 1. Link in thread.
alejandro: Short version?
Maya (People Ops): TL;DR: expanded emergency leave (natural disaster/evac) eligibility for remote-first employees, clarified termination PTO payout formulas per country, and introduced a 3-step manager checklist for approvals.
rachel (Payroll): Payroll will need final participant lists by May 25 for accrual changes. We'll also update the final pay calculation doc.
sam (Legal): Flag: some jurisdictions disallow accelerated payout without consent. Legal will append notes per country.
oncall-bot: Policy doc posted: https://intranet.redwood.com/policies/emergency-leave (automated)
Maya (People Ops): Actions: 1) Managers: review checklist for team members who may be impacted. 2) People Ops partners: share editable slides for local town halls. 3) Employees: read FAQ and DM People Ops for exceptions.
alejandro: Can contractors be granted emergency leave in exceptional cases?
Maya (People Ops): Contractors remain on contract terms; exceptions require Legal + Finance sign-off.
Maya (People Ops): We'll host a 20-min Q&A May 5 10am PT. Recording will be posted. Questions -> #people-ops or hr@redwood.com :bell:
